title: Linearising E = ½CV²
caption: Plotting E against V² turns the curve into a straight line through the origin. Its gradient is C/2 = 0.235 mJ V⁻², so C = 2 × gradient = 470 μF.
alt: Five points of stored energy in millijoules against voltage squared, on a straight line through the origin.
description: Least-squares gradient 0.2352 mJ V⁻², intercept 0 mJ, close to zero as the model predicts.
